description: Total weekly physical activity in MET-minutes.
notes: Sum over 5 domains of days/week x minutes/day x MET weight (vigorous work 8, moderate work 4, walk/bike for transport 4, vigorous recreation 8, moderate recreation 4; WHO GPAQ guide). description: Meets the physical activity guideline (>= 600 MET-min/week, about 150 min moderate).
